final: WITH joined AS (SELECT cc.transref AS tref, t.tradekind AS ttype, cc.prevviol AS pv FROM compliancecase cc JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = cc.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref), grp AS (SELECT tref, ttype, AVG(pv) AS gavg FROM joined GROUP BY tref, ttype), overall AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM grp), ratios AS (SELECT g.tref, g.ttype, g.gavg, g.gavg / o.oavg AS ratio FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.oavg IS NOT NULL), typeavg AS (SELECT ttype, AVG(ratio) AS tavg FROM ratios GROUP BY ttype), kept AS (SELECT r.tref, r.ttype, r.gavg, r.ratio, r.ratio - ta.tavg AS diff FROM ratios r JOIN typeavg ta ON r.ttype = ta.ttype WHERE r.ratio > ta.tavg) SELECT AVG(gavg), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM kept
